cohort: The study enrolled 2007 neonates from six hospitals in Baghdad.
finding: The incidence of birth defects in Baghdad was 28/1000 live births, with multiple congenital anomalies, gastrointestinal, central nervous, and musculoskeletal systems defects being the most frequent, and possible risk factors included maternal age, reduced fetal movement, prematurity, and not receiving tonics during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Among neonates with birth defects, 66.2% were born via cesarean section, and this association was statistically significant.
